name: Himanshu Jena

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Himanshu Jena, also published as Himanshu Bhushan Jena, is a bilingual poet from Raipur in Odisha’s Jajpur district. His collections include Tranquil Rapture, Spring of Serenity and Ripples of Reflection. The last was published by Booksclinic Publishing in 2020.

His Kabita Live poems use fire, flowers and light to speak about integrity and purposeful action. ‘Walking in Fire’ imagines resolve as a force that can answer difficult circumstances. ‘Body, the Catalyst for Supreme Alchemy’ and ‘Staying True to Oneself’ turn to the relationship between the mortal body and an enduring inner life, measuring that life through conduct and concern for humanity.
